high.title: Exchange Rate USD Forecast, Savings Interest Rates and Banking System Liquidity in Q2/2026
high.summary: Vietcombank Securities (VCBS) reports that USD/VND exchange rate pressure is expected to continue in Q2/2026. The central rate declined 19 dong to 25,102 VND/USD in Q1, while commercial bank rates dropped to 26,357 VND/USD. However, the black market rate surged 520 dong to 26,920 VND/USD by end-Q1. The SBV has deployed 180-day forward USD sales at 26,850 VND/USD to banks to manage pressure. Exchange rate volatility reflects concerns about the Fed delaying monetary easing longer than expected, plus rising geopolitical risks strengthening USD's safe-haven appeal. VCBS forecasts continued pressure on VND in Q2 as global uncertainties persist, requiring close monitoring of SBV intervention measures and their effectiveness in stabilizing the currency.

high.title: Q1/2026 Business Results Update for MB, VPBank, ACB: One Bank Achieves 9,500 Billion VND Pre-tax Profit
high.summary: Major Vietnamese banks reported strong Q1/2026 results. MB achieved consolidated pre-tax profit of 9,500 billion VND (+13.3% YoY), with standalone bank profit of 8,866 billion VND (+15.3%). Credit grew 3.3% to 1.146 trillion VND and deposits increased 0.73% to 1.07 trillion VND. Revenue reached 22,822 billion VND (+21.5% YoY). ACB reported pre-tax profit of 5,400 billion VND (+56% QoQ, +17% YoY), with credit growth of 3.2% and deposit growth of 1%. The strong banking sector performance supports VND stability and reflects healthy credit demand, which is positive for Vietnam's economic growth prospects and could reduce pressure on the SBV to intervene heavily in FX markets.

medium.title: Securities Companies Unexpectedly Lower VN-Index Forecast
medium.summary: KB Securities Vietnam (KBSV) has revised down its 2026 market EPS growth forecast to 11% from 15.7% previously, citing Middle East geopolitical tensions affecting inflation, exchange rates, and interest rates. The revision reflects more cautious outlook amid liquidity shortages and real estate credit controls.

medium.title: Dragon Capital Comments on Recent VN-Index Volatility
medium.summary: Dragon Capital reports VN-Index fell 11.9% in March (USD terms) due to global geopolitical risks, but showed signs of stabilization by month-end. Daily trading value maintained around $1.3 billion, supported mainly by domestic flows while foreign flows remained mixed.

medium.title: Mirae Asset Director: Market Correction is Good for "Refreshing" Capital Flows, 3 Stock Groups May Lead
medium.summary: Mirae Asset's director sees positive momentum in VN-Index with large-cap stocks leading the market recovery. The correction allowed for capital rotation and established more sustainable pricing levels, with expectations for continued upward movement driven by Q1/2026 earnings results.

medium.title: First Private Bank to Have Collateral Assets Exceeding 3 Trillion
medium.summary: VPBank reports collateral assets reached 3.049 trillion VND by end-Q1/2026, up 10.7% from year-end 2025, making it the largest private bank by collateral value. Real estate collateral comprises 719,000 billion VND (23.6% of total), growing 5.3% quarterly.

medium.title: Update on Securities Companies Q1 Results: VPBankS and VDSC Disappointing
medium.summary: 31 securities companies have reported Q1/2026 results. VPBankS led with revenue of 2,871 billion VND (4x YoY growth) and pre-tax profit of 515 billion VND (+47% YoY). KIS Securities achieved 254 billion VND pre-tax profit (+90% YoY), while VIX Securities disappointed despite revenue growth.

medium.title: Hot: Advising Stock Trading Without License Will Face Strict Penalties
medium.summary: Government warns that individuals and organizations providing stock trading advice without proper licensing from the State Securities Commission will face strict penalties under Securities Law Article 12. Investors are advised to be cautious of unlicensed sources on social media.

medium.title: Agribank, BIDV, ACB Announce Important Notice Regarding Money Transfer Transactions
medium.summary: Major banks announce system maintenance affecting interbank payments via NAPAS from 22:00 April 19 to 00:50 April 20, and again from 22:00 April 23 to 00:50 April 24. Various e-banking and mobile banking services will be temporarily disrupted during these periods.

medium.title: VPBank Latest Interest Rates: Which Term Has Highest Rate After Adjustment?
medium.summary: VPBank maintains maximum 4.75%/year for terms under 6 months. For longer terms, rates are differentiated by deposit amount: 6-9 months at 5.90%/year for deposits under 1 billion VND, 10-24 months at 6.10%/year, with 36-month terms at 5.40%/year.

medium.title: Techcombank Latest Interest Rates: Which Term Currently Has Highest Rate?
medium.summary: Techcombank offers up to 4.75%/year for terms under 6 months. Counter deposit rates range from 6.30-6.50%/year for 6-12 month terms, with highest rates for deposits over 3 billion VND at 6.40-6.60%/year depending on term length.

medium.title: BIDV Has Notice for All Customers
medium.summary: BIDV announces system upgrades from 03:00-05:30 on April 18 and 19, 2026, during which some banking services will be temporarily interrupted. Customers advised to plan transactions accordingly to avoid inconvenience.
